nodes.label: AdminLTE 3 Admin Theme Contract
nodes.rationale: The admin shell depends on AdminLTE 3 class names (content-wrapper, content-header, sidebar-mini, main-sidebar, nav-sidebar, has-treeview, badge) plus bootstrap-rtl.min.css for RTL rendering. Custom wrappers like custom-style.css and amsify.select.css layer on top; changing the AdminLTE major version would silently break every admin page's markup.

nodes.label: Static Asset URL Contract (/assets)
nodes.rationale: Templates hardcode absolute '/assets/...' URLs, so the directory layout under public/assets is a frozen contract between HTML and the static file mount. Asset paths are not parameterized or templated, so re-vendoring an asset requires editing head.html / footer.html by hand.
